title: 第11章 神药

第11章神药
朱棣听罢，斜了张軏一眼。
奇迹又发生了，张軏就好像瞬间被人掐断了脖子的鸡，啪的一下脑袋耷拉下去。
即便是张辅这般沉稳的人，在旁也气得脸色略显发青。
张家也算是满门的英杰，不说张玉，就说张辅，年纪轻轻便开始崭露头角，谁料家里出了张軏这么个憨货，实在有辱家门。
朱棣只感到好气又好笑，检视过张軏的病情，却也无话，当日回宫。
只是对于张軏的病情，朱棣依旧关注。
谁料过了几日，情况却变得糟糕起来。
原本只是皮肉伤，不过近几日天气炎热，朱棣传召太医询问病情，太医却开始支支吾吾起来。
朱棣察觉有些不对，是以厉声道：“有话直言无妨。”
这太医跪伏得更低，战战兢兢地道：“陛……陛下，张公子的病情似有恶化的迹象，臣见其患处……肿疡已生……只恐……只恐……”
所谓的肿疡，其实就是伤口发炎了，而且因为外伤比较严重，再加上天气炎热，伤口的炎症久治不愈的话，若是不能立即消炎，在这个时代，就可能危及生命了。
一听到肿疡二字，朱棣的脸色微微一变。
他显然是知道肿疡二字的分量的，毕竟是行伍出身的皇帝，当初靖难，不知道多少将士，往往就死在因刀伤导致的肿疡上头。
而让朱棣最记忆犹新的，莫过于朱棣的岳父徐达。
徐达一代名将，便是因为身发毒疮而死，而这所谓的毒疮和背疽，其实就是肿疡。
市井传闻，说是徐达生了毒疮和背疽，朱元璋命人赐下烧鹅，烧鹅是发物，因而将徐达害死。
当然……这是无稽之谈，且不说生了这玩意和吃烧鹅便导致病情恶化没有丝毫关联，最重要的是…背疽和毒疮亦或者肿疡，在这个时代的死亡率本就不低。
而且当时的徐达驻守北平，朱元璋却在南京城，从南京送烧鹅到北平去……
朱棣冷冷地看着御医：“太医院可有对症良药？”

这太医也不傻，像这样的病，本就是完全凭借运气，说穿了，就看张軏自己能不能熬过去，这个时候若是打保票，到时出了意外，这不是找死吗？
这太医期期艾艾地道：“臣……臣只怕毒疮入体……到时便神仙也难救了。”
朱棣勃然大怒：“朕要尔等有何用？”
太医直接吓得魂不附体。
其实这天下并不是没有真正的良医。
不过大明宫廷的御医生们的水平却是良莠不齐。
这也怪不得别人，完全是因为太祖高皇帝整出来的一套机制出了问题，比如太医院的太医们……大多是世袭的。
没错……他是世袭。
眼前这个太医，之所以能成为太医，从而进入宫廷成为御医，是因为他爹就是御医。
一般的病，他倒是能处理，可遇到复杂一些的，就可能只能抓瞎了。
不过御医毕竟是御医，御医是有家学渊源的，他们可能治病不厉害，但是如何规避风险，却是耳熟能详。
有的御医可能技能点点在治病在，可这样的御医在宫廷之中未必长久。
而真正能长寿的御医，往往技能都点在了怎么撇清关系上。
“陛下，张公子遭受酷刑，创口实在太大，何况他毕竟年幼，身子赢弱，如今毒疮迸发，臣不敢说是不治之症，只是这生死却全要看天数了。”
上半句是告诉朱棣，那些行刑的人下手太重了，都怪这些人下如此狠手。
下半句则是直接说，这是老天爷的事，是生是死，全看老天爷的心情。
朱棣深吸一口气，竟是默然，良久之后，才道：“全力救治。”
“喏。”御医如蒙大赦，自是匆匆告退。
…………
张安世躲在张家的外头，直到张家的中门张开，紧接着那五军都督府都指挥同知张辅带着几个亲兵骑着马离了家，他才像箭一般冲出去，嗖的一下钻进了张府。

在入府的过程中，张安世居然发现自己的观察能力惊人，张家的院墙，哪一处高，哪一处矮，哪一个地方适合攀爬，哪一个地方紧靠某处无人街巷，竟只是眼睛一扫，便了然于胸。
都听说那些百战的将军无论到了哪里，只需一看地形，便能耳熟能详的排兵布阵，没想到他居然也有这方面的才能，无论走到哪里，都能找到翻墙而出的有利地形，这样的天赋，不去做贼真的可惜。
几日不见，张軏的病情显然是更重了，远远超出了张安世的意料之外。
张軏这一次依旧还是唧唧哼哼的，只不过却有气无力。
“三弟，三弟……”
“大……大哥……”
张軏听到熟悉的声音，微微抬头，然后勉强挤出了一些笑容。
张安世见他这样子，却是急了，皱起眉头道：“怎么啦，怎么啦？”
张軏断断续续道：“我头疼的厉害，伤口处没知觉了，他们说病的很重，大哥，我是不是要死了，我不想死啊。”
张安世摸了摸他的额头，发烧了。
再掀开被褥，却发现趴在床塌上的张軏撅着自己的屁股，而伤口处却是不忍卒睹，分明是伤口化脓了。
若是一般的伤口倒也罢了，主要是伤口很大，因而显得触目惊心。
这很明显是感染和炎症导致的，同时引发了高烧。
张安世道：“我的药用了吗？”
“没用，御医开了药方。”
张安世便挑眉道：“该用我的药。”
张軏抬头看一眼张安世。
张安世道：“你还信不过我？”
“自然是信得过大哥的……我说的是大哥的品行。”
看着半死不活的张軏，张安世咬牙切齿地道：“我的医术比品行好。”

张軏虽然年少，却也不至于傻到连这个想不明白：“大哥有这份心便好了，我头昏沉沉的厉害，难受的很，大哥……我要死了，我昨夜一宿未睡……听御医们窃窃私语，说情况很糟糕，我……我难受极了。”
张安世见他闷闷不乐，也不催促他用药，而是想办法先让他心情好起来：“你知不知道，老二朱勇回家，被他爹吊起来打。”
张軏一听，似乎来了兴趣，找回了一点气力似的，张大眼睛道：“呀。”
“不骗你，朱家人都看到了。”
“没想到二哥也这么惨。”
“是啊，我们三兄弟太惨了。”
“可是大哥……”
“我也惨，虽然都是打在你们的身上，却疼在我的心里啊。”张安世道。
张軏此时显得疲惫极了，他脸色苍白，口里含糊不清地道：“大哥，俺真是命苦，俺没了爹，现在看来也活不成啦，兄长成日骂俺，说俺和大哥厮混，游手好闲，才有此祸。俺也知道，大哥有时也会糊弄俺做一些糊涂事，可是……不知怎的，跟着大哥结伴，总是自在，俺在府里便不开心，见了大哥便高兴了。
他断断续续地说着，语速越来越慢。
张安世禁不住吸了吸鼻子，道：“你歇着，我给你上药。”
说着去搜他上回送来的药瓶，寻到之后，便将药水倒出来，一点点地擦拭在张軏的患处。
这姿势和举动，显然是不雅的，不过现在也顾不得许多。
上过了药，张安世便道：“你好好歇着吧，我翻墙走了。”
“翻……翻墙……”
“诶，这不是练练手嘛，以后来看你的时候用得着。”
张軏意识模糊，眼皮子都显得沉重了，便没有再挽留。

Chapter 11 Miracle Medicine
After Zhu Di heard this, he glanced sideways at Zhang Fu.
A miracle happened again. Zhang Fu was like a chicken whose neck was suddenly strangled, and his head drooped with a snap.
Even a calm person like Zhang Fu was so angry that his face turned slightly green.
The Zhang family can be considered a family full of heroes, not to mention Zhang Yu, but Zhang Fu, who started to rise to prominence at a young age. Unexpectedly, having such a fool as Zhang Fu in the family is really a disgrace to the family.
Zhu Di only felt angry and funny. He checked Zhang Fu's condition, but had nothing to say, so he returned to the palace that day.
But Zhu Di was still concerned about Zhang Fu's condition.
Unexpectedly, a few days later, the situation became worse.
It was originally just a flesh wound, but the weather has been hot in recent days. Zhu Di summoned the imperial physician to inquire about his condition, but the imperial physician began to hesitate.
Zhu Di noticed something was wrong, so he said sternly: "It's okay to speak out."
The imperial doctor knelt down even lower and said tremblingly: "Your Majesty... Your Majesty, Mr. Zhang's condition seems to be worsening. I saw the affected area...swellings have appeared...I'm afraid...I'm afraid..."
The so-called swelling is actually an inflammation of the wound, and because the trauma is relatively serious and the weather is hot, if the inflammation of the wound is not cured for a long time, if the inflammation cannot be eliminated immediately, in this era, it may be life-threatening.
Upon hearing the word "swelling", Zhu Di's expression changed slightly.
He obviously knew the importance of the word "swelling". After all, he was an emperor who was born in the military. During the Jingnan War, countless soldiers often died of swellings caused by knife wounds.
What Zhu Di remembers the most is Zhu Di's father-in-law Xu Da.
Xu Da, a famous general of the generation, died of sores on his body. The so-called sores and back gangrene were actually swellings.
There are rumors in the market that Xu Da suffered from malignant sores and back ulcers. Zhu Yuanzhang ordered people to give him a roasted goose. Roasted geese are considered to be hairy things, so Xu Da was killed.
Of course... this is nonsense, not to mention that the birth of this thing has nothing to do with the worsening of the condition caused by eating roast goose. The most important thing is... the mortality rate of back gangrene, malignant sores, or swelling in this era is not low.
Moreover, Xu Da was stationed in Peiping at that time, but Zhu Yuanzhang was in Nanjing, sending roast geese from Nanjing to Peiping...
Zhu Di looked at the imperial doctor coldly: "Does the Imperial Hospital have any good medicine?"
This imperial doctor is not stupid. A disease like this depends entirely on luck. To put it bluntly, it depends on whether Zhang Fu can survive it. If he takes a guarantee at this time, if there is an accident, isn't he courting death?
The imperial doctor said: "I...I am afraid that the poisonous sores will enter my body...then even gods will be unable to save me."
Zhu Di was furious: "What use do I have for you?"
The imperial doctor was frightened out of his wits.
In fact, it is not that there are no truly good doctors in this world.
However, the quality of the imperial doctors in the Ming Dynasty varied greatly.
This is no wonder to others, it is entirely because there is something wrong with the mechanism put in place by Emperor Taizu Gao. For example, the doctors at the Imperial Hospital...most of them are hereditary.
That's right...he's hereditary.
The reason why the imperial doctor in front of me became an imperial physician and entered the palace as an imperial physician was because his father was an imperial physician.
He can deal with ordinary diseases, but if he encounters more complicated ones, he may have no choice but to scratch his head.
However, imperial doctors are imperial doctors after all. Imperial doctors have family backgrounds. They may not be good at treating diseases, but they are familiar with how to avoid risks.
Some imperial doctors may have some skills in treating diseases, but such imperial doctors may not last long in the palace.
And the skills of imperial doctors who can truly live a long life often focus on how to clear up relationships.
"Your Majesty, Mr. Zhang was tortured and the wounds were too great. Besides, he is still young and his body is weak. Now the sores are erupting. I dare not say it is an incurable disease, but his life or death depends on the fate of the day."
The first half of the sentence is to tell Zhu Di that those who executed the execution were too harsh and it is all their fault.So cruel.
The second half of the sentence directly says that this is God's business. Whether you live or die depends on God's mood.
Zhu Di took a deep breath and was silent. After a long time, he said: "Treat him with all his strength."
"Here." The imperial doctor hurriedly left as if he had been granted amnesty.
…………
Zhang Anshi hid outside Zhang's house until the middle door of Zhang's house opened. Immediately after Zhang Fu, commander of the Fifth Army Governor's Mansion, left home on horseback with a few soldiers, he rushed out like an arrow and entered Zhang's house with a whoosh.
During the process of entering the house, Zhang Anshi discovered that his observation ability was amazing. Among the Zhang family's courtyard walls, which part was high and which part was short, which part was suitable for climbing, and which part was close to an uninhabited street, he could clearly understand it with just a glance.
We all heard that generals who have fought hundreds of battles can easily arrange their troops in familiar formations just by looking at the terrain. I didn't expect that he also has this talent. No matter where he goes, he can find favorable terrain to climb over the wall. With such a talent, it would be a pity not to become a thief.
After not seeing each other for a few days, Zhang Fu's condition obviously became more serious, far beyond Zhang Anshi's expectation.
Zhang Fu was still chirping and humming this time, but he was weak.
"Third brother, third brother..."
"Big...brother..."
Zhang Fu heard the familiar voice, raised his head slightly, and then forced out a smile.
Seeing him like this, Zhang Anshi became anxious, frowned and said, "What's the matter, what's the matter?"
Zhang Fu said intermittently: "I have a severe headache and I can't feel the wound. They said I'm very ill. Brother, am I going to die? I don't want to die."
Zhang Anshi touched his forehead and found that he had a fever.
When he opened the quilt again, he found Zhang Fu lying on the bed with his butt sticking out. However, the wound was ugly and it was obviously suppurating.
If it were an ordinary wound, it would be fine. The main reason was that the wound was so large that it looked shocking.
This is obviously caused by infection and inflammation, which also triggers a high fever.
Zhang Anshi said: "Has my medicine been used?"
"It's useless. The imperial doctor prescribed the medicine."
Zhang Anshi raised his eyebrows and said, "You should use my medicine."
Zhang Fu raised his head and glanced at Zhang Anshi.
Zhang Anshi said: "You still can't trust me?"
"Of course I can trust my eldest brother...I'm talking about my eldest brother's character."
Looking at the half-dead Zhang Fu, Zhang Anshi gritted his teeth and said: "My medical skills are better than my conduct."
Although Zhang Fu is young, he is not so stupid that he can't even figure this out: "It's good if my brother has this intention. My head is so dizzy and I feel very uncomfortable. Brother... I'm going to die. I didn't sleep all night long... I heard the doctors whispering that the situation is very bad. I... I feel very uncomfortable."
Seeing that he was depressed, Zhang Anshi did not urge him to take medicine, but tried to make him feel better first: "Did you know that when the second child, Zhu Yong, came home, he was hung up and beaten by his father."
When Zhang Fu heard this, he seemed to be interested and regained some strength. He opened his eyes wide and said, "Yeah."
"I'm not going to lie to you, everyone in the Zhu family has seen it."
"I didn't expect my second brother to be so miserable."
"Yeah, it's so miserable for us three brothers."
"But brother..."
"It's miserable for me too. Although they were all hit on you, it hurts in my heart." Zhang Anshi said.
Zhang Fu looked extremely tired at this time. His face was pale and he said vaguely: "Brother, my life is really hard. I have lost my father, and it seems that I can't survive now. My brother scolds me all the time, saying that I hang out with my eldest brother and am idle. This is a disaster because of my free time. I also know that my eldest brother sometimes fools me into doing stupid things, but... somehow, I always feel at ease with my eldest brother. I am not happy in the house, but I am happy when I see my eldest brother.
He spoke intermittently, slowly and slowly.
Zhang Anshi couldn't help but sniffed and said, "Just rest, I'llGive you medicine. "
Then he went to search for the medicine bottle he sent last time. After finding it, he poured out the medicine and wiped it on Zhang Fu's affected area bit by bit.
This posture and behavior are obviously indecent, but I can't care less now.
After taking the medicine, Zhang Anshi said: "You should have a good rest, I will climb over the wall and leave. "
"Climb...over the wall..."
"Hey, isn't this a practice exercise? I'll need it when I visit you later. "
Zhang Fu's consciousness was blurred and his eyelids seemed heavy, so he didn't try to hold him back.
